title: 50ml Fantasi Berries Ice Bundle | 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle
description:
50ml Fantasi Berries Ice 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle:
Summer is here to stay with this great-value Fantasi E-Liquid bundle, featuring all of our most iconic berry flavors !
Whether you’re craving the sweet taste of creamy strawberries, tart raspberries, sugary cherries, or candied blue razz, this kit has something for every mood.
All blasted with supercool ice, these juices are sure to deliver a mouth-watering, refreshing experience.
This kit includes 4x 50ml bottles of our tantalizing 70/30 vape juice available in either 0mg or 3mg of nicotine. Pick from nic salts and freebase nicotine to craft your perfect vaping experience.
Strawberry Ice: A punnet of ice-cool strawberries in every hit, this sweet and creamy juice is geared to provide a sweet, summery experience.
Raspberry Ice:Pucker your lips with sour, sugary raspberries served on a bed of the finest crushed ice.
Cherry Ice: Are you a lover of cool cherryade on a hot summer’s day? Look no further than this delectable blend of glossy cherries and chunky ice cubes.
Blue Raspberry: Packing the same rich, sweet flavors as your favorite blue ice lolly, this blue razz sensation is like a trip down memory lane.
This steal of a bundle contains 4 of our premium berry
Fantasi
E-liquids, all blasted with frosty ice for a sweet, crisp, and satisfying hit. Mixed to a 70/30 ratio of VG and PG, this product is best suited to sub-ohm devices and pod vapes. Available in nicotine-free 0mg, 3mg nic salts, or 3mg freebase nicotine. Nic salts provide a smoother throat hit and a more immediate release of nicotine, while freebase nicotine offers a stronger throat hit and a more gradual release.
Ingredients:
VG – Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
PG – Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Strawberry Ice
1x Raspberry Ice
1x Cherry Ice
1x Blue Raspberry
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
50ml, 60ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg
Flavor
Ice Cool
Highlights:
All your favourite summer berries in one delicious package
70/30 VG to PG ratio for sub-ohm devices
Perfect for thick cloud production!
Choose between nicotine-free, nic salts, and freebase nicotine
